journey.name: Feed Management Journey
journey.description: Verify auto-prepending https:// to feed URLs and editing URLs on click

actions.action: Type "hnrss.org/frontpage" into the "RSS Feed URL" input field
Verify that "https://hnrss.org/frontpage" is displayed in the feed sources list
Verify that the "RSS Feed URL" input field is now empty
Tap the feed item "https://hnrss.org/frontpage" in the feed sources list
Verify that the "RSS Feed URL" input field contains "https://hnrss.org/frontpage"
Verify that the button text changes to "Update Feed"
Clear the input field and type "https://hnrss.org/newest"
Verify that "https://hnrss.org/newest" is displayed in the sources list and "https://hnrss.org/frontpage" is replaced
Verify that the button text resets to "Add Feed"
